# ZeroLight Design System by Zerorapid

> Public, token-driven B2B SaaS & ERP design system at https://bricks.zerorapid.in with 130 registry payloads, 6-tier atomic architecture, Mathematical Morphic Evolution (M1/M2/M3), and shadcn `/r/` compatibility.

## Quick Endpoints for AI Web Chats & Agents
- Complete Single-File Reference (All 130 Components + Exact Props): https://bricks.zerorapid.in/llms-full.txt
- Component Index (130 items): https://bricks.zerorapid.in/r/index.json
- Individual Component TSX + Props: https://bricks.zerorapid.in/r/{name}.json
- Native ZeroLight Registry: https://bricks.zerorapid.in/registry/{name}.json
- ChatGPT Custom GPT OpenAPI Schema: https://bricks.zerorapid.in/openapi-chatgpt.json

## Non-Negotiable Design Rules (ZeroLight Tactile Calm)
1. **Token-Driven Surfaces Only (`useZeroLight()`)**: Never hardcode hex colors (`#3B82F6`), arbitrary radii, or shadows. Bind to `tokens.universalFillColor`, `tokens.universalBorderColor`, `tokens.textIconColor`, `tokens.primaryButtonColor`, `scaled.scaledCardRadius`, `scaled.scaledRadius`, and `scaled.cardShadow`.
2. **Tabular Numerals**: Use `font-sans tabular-nums` on all KPIs, currency, counts, SKUs, and tables.
3. **Popups Over Sidebars**: Use centered `Modal` / `DetailDrawer` popups for secondary details instead of edge slide-over sidebars.
4. **Morphic Evolution (`M1 | M2 | M3`)**: `stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3"` (or `<MorphicScope stage="M2">`) is supported on core primitives & ERP modules (`Button`, `Input`, `Card`, `StatCard`, `InventoryStockHealth`, `ApprovalWorkflow`, `ThreeWayMatch`, `LedgerBalancer`, `LineItemMatrix`).

## Verified Prop Signatures (Compile-Ready Reference)
Use these exact TypeScript prop names when generating TSX from `@/components/zerolight`:

- **`StatCard`**:
  `label: string; value: string | number; delta?: string; trend?: "up" | "down" | "neutral"; comparisonText?: string; stage?: 1 | 2 | 3 | "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`
  *(Note: uses `label` and `comparisonText`, NOT `title`/`description`.)*

- **`Button`**:
  `variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "destructive"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; loading?: boolean; iconLeft?: ReactNode; iconRight?: ReactNode; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3"; onClick?: () => void;`

- **`Badge`**:
  `variant?: "healthy" | "degraded" | "syncing" | "critical" | "neutral" | "info"; size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md"; showDot?: boolean;`

- **`Modal`**:
  `isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; title?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"; children?: ReactNode;`
  *(Note: uses `isOpen` and `onClose`, NOT `open`/`onOpenChange`.)*

- **`BarChart`**:
  `data: Array<{ label: string; value: number; secondaryValue?: number }>; title?: string; subtitle?: string; primaryLabel?: string; secondaryLabel?: string; mode?: "grouped" | "stacked";`

- **`DataTable<T>`**:
  `columns?: Array<{ key: string; header: ReactNode; align?: "left" | "right" | "center"; render?: (row: T) => ReactNode }>; rows?: T[]; rowKey?: (row: T, index: number) => string; onRowClick?: (row: T) => void; showToolbar?: boolean;`
  *(Note: uses `rows` and `columns[{ key, header }]`, NOT `data` or `accessorKey`.)*

- **`InventoryStockHealth`**:
  `sku: string; name: string; warehouseBin: string[]; onHand: number; reorderPoint: number; maxCapacity: number; unit?: string; onReorder?: (sku: string) => void; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`

- **`ApprovalWorkflow`**:
  `documentId: string; title: string; amountLabel: string; requester: string; budgetImpact: string; steps: Array<{ id: string; role: string; approver: string; status: "approved" | "pending" | "rejected" | "waiting"; timestamp?: string }>; onApprove?: (comment: string) => void; onReject?: (reason: string) => void; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`

- **`ThreeWayMatch`**:
  `poNumber: string; grnNumber: string; invoiceNumber: string; currency?: string; lines: Array<{ sku: string; description: string; poQty: number; grnQty: number; invoiceQty: number; poUnitPrice: number; invoiceUnitPrice: number }>; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`

- **`LedgerBalancer`**:
  `journalId?: string; fiscalPeriod?: string; periodLocked?: boolean; currency?: string; initialLines: Array<{ id: string; accountCode: string; accountName: string; debit: number; credit: number }>; onPostJournal?: (lines) => void; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`

- **`LineItemMatrix`**:
  `title?: string; currency?: string; initialItems: Array<{ id: string; sku: string; name: string; qty: number; unitPrice: number; taxPct: number }>; onSave?: (items, grandTotal) => void; stage?: "M1" | "M2" | "M3";`

## CLI Installation
- Node CLI: `npx zerolight add <component|block/name>`
- Native Rust CLI: `zerolight add <component>`, `zerolight check ./src`, `zerolight diff <component>`
- MCP Server: `node bin/zerolight-mcp.mjs`
